Rule 4: Lantern.assist.parseReply/run, Lantern.aiResultChecks.check/rechain, and L.CHAT.converse with a fake model that writes the same reply twice. Rule 5: Lantern.healthLessons, Lantern.healthNeed, L.CHAT.kindOf. Expected answers worked out by hand. No real model was run.
